question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Vacate
solution:
The correct answer is **"Depart."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Vacate"** means to leave or abandon a place or position. (दूसरे के लिए (मकान, सीट आदि) ख़ाली करना, (अपना स्‍थान या पद) छोड़ना)

 
 
• **Example**: *When he left the university, he had to **vacate**__ his university-provided housing.*
 
 
 
• **"Depart"** is a synonym of **"vacate."**
 
• **"Depart" **means to leave or go away from a place. ((कहीं से, कहीं के लिए) प्रस्‍थान करना, रवाना होना)
 __
 
• **Example**: *The train **departed**__ from Nagpur.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Fabricate** means to make up or invent a story or lie. (मनगढ़ंत बातें करना, झूठी बातें गढ़ना, विरचना करना)
 
• **Remember** means to recall or bring to mind something from the past. (व्यक्ति या वस्‍तु का ध्‍यान रहना या उसे याद करना)
 
• **Strain** means to put pressure or stress on something. (किसी काम के लिए काफ़ी अधिक मानसिक या शारीरिक श्रम करना)
